bio: Interior design for small apartments: warm light, clever storage and rooms that finally feel finished.
avatar: Portrait of a woman in her mid 30s with dark curly hair and gold earrings, standing in a sunlit modern living room, confident smile, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a bright minimalist living room with a linen sofa, plants and warm afternoon light, subject across the middle band, cinematic

collections.title: Small spaces
videos: Styling a shelf in three minutes

videos.title: Studio apartment, before the makeover
videos.description: A small room, a bad layout and a plan.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a cluttered small studio apartment with mismatched furniture and boxes in flat daylight, no people, no text
videos.motion: Slow camera dolly through the room as light shifts from the window, dust floats.

videos.title: Studio apartment, after
videos.description: The same room: one sofa, one lamp, much more air.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a bright tidy small studio apartment with a linen sofa, warm lamp, plants and wooden shelves, warm afternoon light, no people, no text
videos.motion: Slow camera dolly through the room as warm light glows and curtains move gently.

videos.title: Styling a shelf in three minutes
videos.description: Books, one plant and a ceramic: the rule of three.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of hands arranging a ceramic vase, books and a small plant on a wooden shelf, warm light, no face, no text
videos.motion: Hands place the vase and adjust a book, light shifts, subtle camera push-in.

videos.title: Lamp light changes everything
videos.description: The same corner at noon and at night.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a cozy reading corner with an armchair, a throw and a warm floor lamp glowing at dusk, no people, no text
videos.motion: The lamp glows warm as the daylight fades outside the window, slow push-in.
